title: kind:26005 — tamper alert (counts, not paths)
description:
RuntimeEvent::TamperAlert (crates/swarm-runtime/src/runtime_events.rs:249-256) NARROWED: the Vec<String> unexpected_library_loads becomes a count plus a hash, and the free-form `details` String is dropped entirely. Both are host filesystem disclosure on a community-global frame.

The paths and the detail string ARE carried on the durable swarm:escalation:v1 lane card with cause=tamper_fail_closed, which is channel-scoped and membership-gated. This frame is the alarm; that card is the record.

Note that this is the ONE runtime event a scoped caller on GET /v1/events/stream is DENIED while an anonymous caller receives it: resolve_demo_scope returns Ok(requested_scope) with no verification when context_token is absent (crates/swarm-ingest-runtime/src/ingest/mod.rs:636-652) and runtime_event_matches_scope short-circuits true on an empty scope (:699-701), while a token-bearing scoped caller is refused at :766-768. Perch does not consume that stream; B5 fixes it.

AGGREGATES-ONLY. This frame is community-global and reaches every member of the colony's Buzz community, including members on no case: handle_ephemeral_event's channel-less branch publishes to Redis EventTopic::Global under a Uuid::nil() routing sentinel and fans out with channel_id=None (crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/event.rs:875-903), and filter_fanout_by_access returns every match at :177-179 for a channel-less event after applying only the receiver tenant label, AUTHOR_ONLY_KINDS and SHARED_GATED_KINDS. No host id, no indicator, no finding id, no library path and no non-opaque join key may appear here.

ADMITTED-ISSUER RULE. A frame renders only if the NOSTR EVENT's pubkey resolves to an admitted bridge identity; others are counted and dropped, and the count is visible. Without it, any chat-capable member of the community can publish one: the ephemeral ingest gate is a single scope test with no per-kind allowlist (`if !scopes.is_empty() && !scopes.contains(&Scope::MessagesWrite)`, crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/event.rs:699-707). The shipped precedent for the predicate is getConfigNudgeAuthorPubkey (desktop/src/features/messages/ui/configNudgeAuthPubkey.ts:22-34), which authenticates against message.signerPubkey — the RAW EVENT SIGNER — and not message.pubkey, which may be a relay-delegated display author.

issuer.description: The bridge's spine identity, for display only. THE ADMITTED-ISSUER RULE MATCHES THE NOSTR EVENT'S `pubkey`, NOT THIS FIELD — this one is inside the content an adversary controls.

seq.description: Per-kind monotonic counter assigned by the bridge. A gap between two frames the console actually received proves loss on a live connection; it says nothing about frames emitted while the console was disconnected, because ephemerals are never stored (crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/event.rs:794-906 writes nothing to Postgres in either branch).

unexpected_library_sha256.description: sha256 over the newline-joined, lexicographically sorted path list. Two alerts can be compared for identity without a path crossing this frame.

x-transport.why_no_relay_change: handle_event short-circuits every 20000-29999 kind into handle_ephemeral_event and RETURNS at crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/event.rs:751, before ingest_event is reached at :761, so required_scope_for_kind never sees a 26xxx. Proved in-tree by the test ephemeral_kinds_not_in_scope_allowlist at crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/ingest.rs:3851-3854.
x-transport.websocket_only: POST /events goes straight into ingest_event (crates/buzz-relay/src/api/bridge.rs:925) with no ephemeral branch, so an HTTP-posted 26xxx is rejected 'restricted: unknown event kind'. The bridge must hold a live WebSocket.
